executive_summary: Build /admin/michael in the EHG frontend: a real dashboard replacing the interim Google-Doc brief copy, JSON-rendering Michael's two-zone brief via bearer-authenticated calls to EHG_Engineer's existing API.

functional_requirements.requirement: Register /admin/michael and /admin/michael/:date routes through the standard admin shell
functional_requirements.description: Create src/pages/admin/MichaelBrief.tsx modeled on src/pages/admin/ProtocolLint.tsx. Register both routes in src/routes/adminRoutes.tsx through the existing AdminRoute -> ProtectedRouteWrapper -> Suspense -> AdminLayout chain (mirroring the ~190-203 param-route pattern), lazy-imported. Add a nav entry to ADMIN_NAV_ITEMS in src/components/admin/AdminLayout.tsx.
acceptance_criteria: Navigating to /admin/michael as an authenticated admin renders the page inside the standard AdminLayout shell
/admin/michael/:date renders the same page for a specific ET date
A nav link to the page appears in the admin sidebar

functional_requirements.requirement: Fetch and render Michael's brief as structured JSON, never the pre-rendered HTML document
functional_requirements.description: Add getMichaelBriefLatest()/getMichaelBrief(date) methods to src/services/adminApi.ts (or a new michaelApi.ts) calling GET /api/michael/brief/latest and /:date, which return exactly {data_json, verified, enriched_at, assembled_at}. Never request or embed the ?format=html response -- it returns a complete HTML document (<!DOCTYPE html>...</html>) with no safe embed path in this repo (no iframe precedent, dangerouslySetInnerHTML only used for sanitized fragments elsewhere).
acceptance_criteria: The page's network calls target the default (non-html) JSON endpoint only
grep for dangerouslySetInnerHTML or iframe in the new files returns nothing
TypeScript types for MichaelBriefData mirror data_json's frozen schema-2 shape (frontPage, enrichment, lede, headsUp, logs)

functional_requirements.requirement: Render the two-zone layout: must-act front page and skippable enrichment zone
functional_requirements.description: Build FrontPageZone.tsx rendering data_json.frontPage {today, gmail, todoist, ehg, claudeCode} above the fold, and EnrichmentZone.tsx rendering data_json.enrichment (v1 renders signals only, per spec). Render lede and headsUp prominently at the top.
acceptance_criteria: FrontPageZone renders today/gmail/todoist/claudeCode sections from fixture data_json without transformation
EnrichmentZone renders only the signals array in v1; other enrichment fields (oracle, watchLater, body, yesterday) are not yet rendered but the component accepts them without erroring
The enrichment zone is visually/structurally distinct and skippable (e.g. collapsed by default or below a clear divider)

functional_requirements.requirement: Render the EHG block as a verbatim pointer, never a re-summary
functional_requirements.description: Build EhgPointerCard.tsx rendering data_json.frontPage.ehg.pointer and handedCount exactly as returned by the API (buildEhgBlock's output shape: {shown, pointer, handedCount}), hiding the card entirely when shown === false. No client-side text generation or fleet-event summarization of any kind.
acceptance_criteria: A unit test asserts the rendered EHG card's displayed text equals fixture data_json.frontPage.ehg.pointer verbatim, character for character
A unit test asserts the card is absent from the DOM when frontPage.ehg.shown is false
No code in EhgPointerCard.tsx references any fleet/coordinator/adam data source other than the passed-in frontPage.ehg object

functional_requirements.requirement: Attach a valid bearer token to every Michael API call and handle auth/data-absence failures explicitly
functional_requirements.description: Route the new Michael API methods through src/lib/authedFetch.ts (which attaches Authorization: Bearer <supabase session.access_token>) rather than adminApi.ts's cookie-only apiFetch, which sends no Authorization header and would 401 against EHG_Engineer's requireAuth-gated /api/michael routes. Follow the precedent in src/hooks/useChairmanDashboardData.ts (authedFetch + explicit 401 handling), consumed by src/components/chairman-v3/BriefingDashboard.tsx. The page must render distinct, honest states for: 401 (not authenticated), 403 (authenticated but not admin -- covers the known user_metadata.role vs app_metadata.role mismatch risk), no brief today (empty/NO_ROW), and 503/tables-absent (michael_brief_runs migration not yet applied).
acceptance_criteria: Every Michael API call carries an Authorization: Bearer header sourced from the live Supabase session
A unit test mocks each of 401, 403, empty-brief, and 503 responses and asserts the page renders a distinct, correctly-labeled state for each -- never a blank screen or a false-success render
No EHG_Engineer-side code is modified to make this work (CORS already permits the EHG origin with credentials and the Authorization header)

technical_requirements.requirement: New tests follow this repo's actual conventions: Vitest + @testing-library/react + jsdom under tests/**, modeled on tests/unit/protocol-lint-dashboard.test.tsx's vi.mock('@/services/adminApi') pattern; Playwright E2E under tests/e2e/admin/, modeled on tests/e2e/admin/admin-protocol-lint.spec.ts's login->navigate->role-assertion shape
technical_requirements.rationale: This is the EHG repo, not EHG_Engineer -- its own test tooling and conventions apply, confirmed by direct inspection of vitest.config.ts and playwright.config.ts rather than assumed from the LEO protocol repo's setup.

technical_requirements.requirement: No change to EHG_Engineer's server/routes/michael.js or server/index.js CORS configuration
technical_requirements.rationale: VALIDATION confirmed CORS already allows the EHG origin with credentials:true and Authorization in allowedHeaders -- this SD's scope is entirely frontend, cross-repo coordination is read-only against an already-correct backend contract.

technical_requirements.requirement: data_json field access is fully typed (MichaelBriefData interface mirrors lib/michael/brief-model.mjs's frozen SCHEMA_VERSION=2 field lists), not accessed via untyped object indexing
technical_requirements.rationale: The schema is explicitly frozen and versioned upstream (TOP_LEVEL_KEYS, FRONT_PAGE_KEYS, ENRICHMENT_KEYS) -- typed access lets a future schema bump fail at compile time rather than silently rendering undefined.

system_architecture.overview: A read-only admin dashboard page in the EHG frontend fetching Michael's daily brief JSON from EHG_Engineer's already-shipped API, rendering it through typed React components mirroring the frozen two-zone schema, authenticated via bearer token rather than the cookie-based pattern most other admin pages in this repo use.

components.name: MichaelBrief.tsx (page)
components.responsibility: Route entry, orchestrates data fetching, loading/error/empty states, and zone composition
components.technology: React function component, react-router-dom useParams for :date

components.name: FrontPageZone.tsx
components.responsibility: Renders the must-act front page (today, gmail, todoist, claudeCode)

components.name: EnrichmentZone.tsx
components.responsibility: Renders the skippable enrichment zone (signals in v1)

components.name: EhgPointerCard.tsx
components.responsibility: Verbatim render of the EHG pointer block, never a re-summary

components.name: michaelApi (adminApi.ts extension or new module)
components.responsibility: Typed fetch methods for the brief endpoints, routed through authedFetch for bearer-token auth

system_architecture.data_flow: Page mount -> michaelApi.getMichaelBriefLatest() (or getMichaelBrief(date) for the dated route) -> authedFetch attaches Authorization: Bearer <session.access_token> -> GET EHG_Engineer's /api/michael/brief/latest or /:date -> JSON {data_json, verified, enriched_at, assembled_at} -> page renders FrontPageZone(data_json.frontPage), EnrichmentZone(data_json.enrichment), EhgPointerCard(data_json.frontPage.ehg), or an explicit 401/403/empty/503 state on failure.
integration_points: EHG_Engineer server/routes/michael.js GET /api/michael/brief/latest and /:date (read-only consumer, no backend change)
src/lib/authedFetch.ts (reused, not modified, for bearer-token attachment)
src/routes/adminRoutes.tsx and src/components/admin/AdminLayout.tsx (route and nav registration)

test_scenarios.scenario: Route renders inside the admin shell
test_scenarios.given: An authenticated admin user navigates to /admin/michael
test_scenarios.then: MichaelBrief.tsx renders inside AdminLayout, nav shows the Michael entry

test_scenarios.scenario: Front page and enrichment zones render fixture data_json without transformation
test_scenarios.given: A mocked successful API response with a fixture data_json (schema 2)
test_scenarios.then: FrontPageZone and EnrichmentZone display the fixture's today/gmail/todoist/claudeCode and signals fields verbatim

test_scenarios.scenario: EHG pointer renders verbatim and hides when shown is false
test_scenarios.given: Two fixtures: one with frontPage.ehg.shown=true and a pointer string, one with shown=false
test_scenarios.then: The first shows the exact pointer text and handedCount; the second renders nothing for the EHG block
A distinct 'not authenticated' state is shown, not a blank screen or the front-page zones
A distinct 'not authorized' state is shown

test_scenarios.given: The mocked API call returns an empty/NO_ROW response
test_scenarios.then: A distinct 'no brief for this date' state is shown, never claiming a brief exists

test_scenarios.given: The mocked API call returns 503 or a tables_absent-shaped error
test_scenarios.then: A distinct 'brief pipeline not yet live' state is shown, not treated as a generic error

test_scenarios.scenario: E2E: login, navigate, verify admin-only access
test_scenarios.given: A logged-in chairman/admin session and a separate non-admin session
test_scenarios.then: The admin session sees the dashboard; the non-admin session is denied, mirroring admin-protocol-lint.spec.ts's role-boundary assertion

acceptance_criteria: The page is reachable at /admin/michael and /admin/michael/:date through the standard admin shell
All Michael API calls carry a bearer token via authedFetch, never the cookie-only adminApi.apiFetch path
The rendered EHG block is a byte-verbatim display of frontPage.ehg.pointer, never client-derived text
401/403/empty/503 states are all explicitly and distinctly handled -- no blank screens, no false-success renders
Zero EHG_Engineer-side code changes

risks.risk: Using adminApi.ts's cookie-only apiFetch by habit (since it is the more commonly used helper in this repo) instead of authedFetch, silently shipping a page that 401s for every real user
risks.mitigation: FR-5's acceptance criteria requires a unit test asserting the Authorization header is present on every Michael API call; code review should explicitly check the import is from authedFetch.ts
risks.rollback_plan: Revert to a feature-flagged state hiding the nav entry until the auth path is fixed; no data or migration involved

risks.risk: The frontend user_metadata.role vs backend app_metadata.role mismatch causes a real admin to see the page shell but get 403 on every API call, with no clear explanation
risks.mitigation: FR-5 explicitly requires a distinct 403 state with a clear message, rather than a generic error; this SD does not attempt to fix the role-shape mismatch itself (out of scope, a cross-cutting concern), only to fail legibly
risks.rollback_plan: N/A -- the 403 state is a UI-only safeguard, not a functional dependency

risks.risk: Embedding the HTML-format brief instead of JSON-rendering, drifting from FR-2's explicit decision under time pressure since it looks like less work
risks.mitigation: FR-2's acceptance criteria includes a grep-based check for dangerouslySetInnerHTML/iframe returning nothing
risks.rollback_plan: Delete the offending embed code and rebuild from data_json; no external dependency to unwind

phases.description: Route/nav/page skeleton (FR-1) plus typed API client with bearer auth (FR-5's plumbing)
Zone components rendering fixture data (FR-2, FR-3, FR-4)
deliverables: unit tests for verbatim EHG rendering

phases.description: Explicit failure-state handling (FR-5's UX half) and E2E coverage

technical_decisions: JSON-render over data_json rather than embedding the HTML-format response, because the HTML is a complete document with no safe embed path in this repo (no iframe precedent, dangerouslySetInnerHTML reserved for sanitized fragments)

Route API calls through authedFetch.ts (bearer token) rather than adminApi.ts's cookie-only apiFetch, following the useChairmanDashboardData.ts/BriefingDashboard.tsx precedent rather than the more commonly copied but auth-incompatible protocol-lint pattern

Explicit, distinct UI states for 401/403/empty/503 rather than a single generic error boundary, since each represents a materially different situation the chairman needs to distinguish (not logged in vs not admin vs no brief yet vs backend not live)

consumers.name: The chairman (admin user)
consumers.interaction: Views the morning brief on the admin dashboard instead of the interim Google Doc copy
consumers.frequency: Daily, replacing child E's interim surface

dependencies.name: EHG_Engineer GET /api/michael/brief/latest and /:date
dependencies.contract: Read-only JSON fetch, {data_json, verified, enriched_at, assembled_at}, bearer-token authenticated
dependencies.failure_handling: 401/403/empty/503 states rendered explicitly per FR-5, never a blank page

data_contracts.schema: frontPage{today,gmail,todoist,ehg,claudeCode}, enrichment{oracle,watchLater,body,yesterday,signals}, lede, headsUp, logs -- frozen at lib/michael/brief-model.mjs
data_contracts.validation: TypeScript interface mirrors the frozen key lists; a schema-version mismatch would be a visible compile-time concern for future maintainers
data_contracts.versioning: Upstream-owned; this page reads schema:2 only, does not negotiate versions

environment_variables: VITE_ENGINEER_URL (existing, used by authedFetch.ts to target the EHG_Engineer backend)
runtime_config.deployment_considerations: No new environment variables or deployment steps; reuses existing cross-app auth plumbing

monitoring: Standard frontend error boundary logging for unexpected (non-401/403/503) failures
observability_rollout.rollout_strategy: Standard PR merge; nav entry visible immediately to all admins once merged
observability_rollout.rollback_trigger: A regression in the page's own test suite on main, or a chairman report of broken/blank rendering
observability_rollout.rollback_procedure: Revert the merge commit; entirely additive frontend code, no data migration to unwind

patterns_identified: Admin page/route/nav registration pattern (ProtocolLint.tsx + adminRoutes.tsx + AdminLayout.tsx)
Two competing frontend-to-EHG_Engineer auth patterns in this repo: cookie-only (adminApi.ts, incompatible with the michael API) and bearer-token (authedFetch.ts, compatible)
Verbatim-passthrough rendering as the mechanism enforcing 'never re-summarize' constraints upstream already relied on (buildEhgBlock)
key_decisions: JSON-render over HTML-embed for the brief content
authedFetch.ts over adminApi.ts's apiFetch for the API client, following the useChairmanDashboardData.ts precedent rather than protocol-lint's cookie-based one
Explicit distinct failure states (401/403/empty/503) rather than a generic error boundary
